13 Four coplanar forces act on a rigid rod, as shown. The rod is hinged at P.
Which force produces the greatest moment about point P?
2 N
4 N
6 N
B
D
C
30°
30°
P
1.0 m
1.0 m
1.0 m
1.0 m
A
10 N

hints: Notice the distance of each force from hinge P along the rod: $1.0 \text{ m}$, $2.0 \text{ m}$, $3.0 \text{ m}$ and $4.0 \text{ m}$.
Recall moment about P uses only the component perpendicular to the rod, so the $30^{\circ}$ forces B and D need $F \sin 30^{\circ}$.
Compare $F_{perp} \times d$ for all four forces in $\text{N m}$ to see which product of perpendicular force and distance is largest.
walkthrough: Read distances from P from the $1.0 \text{ m}$ markers: force A at $1.0 \text{ m}$, B at $2.0 \text{ m}$, C at $3.0 \text{ m}$, D at $4.0 \text{ m}$.
Use moment magnitude $= F_{perp} \times d$, where $F_{perp}$ is the component at $90^{\circ}$ to the rod and $d$ is distance from P.
For perpendicular forces: A gives $10 \text{ N} \times 1.0 \text{ m} = 10 \text{ N m}$ and C gives $2 \text{ N} \times 3.0 \text{ m} = 6 \text{ N m}$.
For angled forces resolve perpendicular to rod with $\sin 30^{\circ} = 0.5$: B gives $6 \sin 30^{\circ} \times 2.0 = 3 \times 2.0 = 6 \text{ N m}$.
Compare magnitudes: $10 \text{ N m} > 8 \text{ N m} > 6 \text{ N m}$, so the $10 \text{ N}$ force at $1.0 \text{ m}$ is greatest. This is option A

A.explanation: The $10 \text{ N}$ force is perpendicular to the rod at $1.0 \text{ m}$ from P, giving $10 \times 1.0 = 10 \text{ N m}$, the largest value.

B.explanation: Only $6 \sin 30^{\circ} = 3 \text{ N}$ is perpendicular at $2.0 \text{ m}$ from P, giving $6 \text{ N m}$, less than the greatest.

C.explanation: The $2 \text{ N}$ force is perpendicular but acts at $3.0 \text{ m}$ from P, giving $2 \times 3.0 = 6 \text{ N m}$.

D.explanation: Only $4 \sin 30^{\circ} = 2 \text{ N}$ is perpendicular at $4.0 \text{ m}$ from P, giving $8 \text{ N m}$, less than the greatest.
